newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 97/98 GDP estimate seen below 2% - officials.
newsitem.headline: Japan 97/98 GDP estimate seen below 2% - officials.

text.p: Japan's gross domestic product (GDP) is forecast to grow at slightly less than two percent in 1997/98, government officials told Reuters on Friday.
The Economic Planning Agency, Finance Ministry and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry are now finalising their official estimates for 1997/98 which are due to be announced next week.
EPA minister Taro Aso has said Japan can achieve its official growth estimate of 2.5 percent in 1996/97.
